meta.name: review-work
meta.description: Post-implementation review orchestrator. Launches 5 parallel background sub-agents: Oracle (goal/constraint verification), Oracle (code quality), Oracle (security), unspecified-high (hands-on QA execution), unspecified-high (context mining from GitHub/git/Slack/Notion). All must pass for review to pass. MUST USE before a PR handoff or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work. Triggers: 'review work', 'review my work', 'review changes', 'QA my work', 'verify implementation', 'check my work', 'validate changes', 'post-implementation review'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 并行发起多路审查，把关已完成工作质量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在交接已完工作前需要多路审查把关。
copy.tagline_en: Launch parallel review agents to validate completed work before handoff.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need parallel review agents to check your completed work before handoff.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会并行启动 5 个后台子代理:核对目标与约束、检查代码质量、审计安全、实际运行应用做 QA、翻查 git/GitHub/Slack/Notion 等上下文;5 项全过才算通过,并给出逐项结论。
howto.when: 在 PR 交接前,或当你明确要求检查已完成的工作时触发;说出“review work”“QA my work”“post-implementation review”等词也会触发。

say.text: review work,帮我审查刚完成的改动
say.note: 5 个后台子代理并行开工。

say.text: 这次实现满足最初需求吗?有没有违反约束
say.note: 目标与约束核对代理给出逐条结论。

say.text: QA my work,实际跑一遍应用再下结论
say.note: 会启动动手运行应用的测试代理。

howto.what_en: Claude launches 5 parallel background sub-agents: goal/constraint verification, code quality review, security audit, hands-on QA by running the app, and context mining from git/GitHub/Slack/Notion. All 5 must pass for the review to pass.
howto.when_en: Triggers before a PR handoff or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work — e.g. saying 'review work', 'QA my work', or 'post-implementation review'.

say_en.text: Review my work — check over the changes I just finished.
Does this implementation meet the original requirements and constraints?
say_en.note: The goal-verification lane checks each point.

say_en.text: QA my work: run the app and test it hands-on.
say_en.note: Spawns a QA agent that actually runs the app.
